items.summary: Result 'observed' with attempted true is refused (importers.py:1459-1468).
started_at treated as an immutable attempt invariant (importers.py:663-664, 112-118); the contract does not say so.
recovery_observations is an unsupported export member (importers.py:346-351, 812); no mismatch rule.
Replay requires the recovery report to be mirrored in observations (importers.py:1371-1373); the new layout is refused.
Legacy layout (report inside observations) is accepted and retained as executor_recovery_report; contract draft refuses it. Owner decision needed on alpha tolerance.
unknown_with_validated_observation has no Replay rule; refused only incidentally by the terminal-event rule (importers.py:1345-1351).
Closed enumerations not enforced (result status, event status, attempt status, time_source accept unknown values, retained verbatim, not coerced); only recovery status is checked.

Closed member sets and x- key checks apply only at the export root, execution_result, recovery report, producer_profile and repository; attempt rows, event rows and control plane attempt rows accept undeclared members.
reconciled_existing marker accepted on a lone row of any non-start status (importers.py:1297-1298); contract allows acknowledged or partial only.
Replay is stricter than the contract: result 'executed' with null observation is refused (importers.py:1384-1385).
Replay requires observations, control_plane_evidence, rejected_observations (and attempt_identity, control_plane_attempts for a versioned export) that the contract leaves optional.
Export-level extensions is validated then dropped; the contract requires consumers to preserve it.
